name: Dick Shuttleworth
features: fair skin, light brown hair, blue eyes, round boyish face, medium build, breezy amateur's expression
bio: Richard Ormonde Shuttleworth won the 1935 Donington Grand Prix in a privately entered Alfa Romeo Tipo B, and spent his inheritance assembling the collection of veteran cars and aircraft that still bears his name. He flew for the RAF and was killed on a night training exercise in August 1940.
